summary: Held throughout. This LONG entry never showed a genuine wrong-direction signature: every pullback (even the sharpest, a full round-trip from +95 to +8 around t=18-19m) stayed above or barely dipped below breakeven and was quickly recovered, with amplitude repeatedly making new highs (53->102->recovering to +90 by the end). Against-fires (KMDR/HA/PROPP) frequently appeared but were inconsistently aligned and never persisted alongside a structural breakdown in price -- momentum/lambda stayed mixed-to-positive on the faster TFs throughout. Next time I'd watch for a giveback that pushes price to a NEW low below the prior dip's low (not just matching it) combined with ALL three fires aligned against AND a sustained negative lambda_hat on the 1m/5m -- that combination never occurred here, which is why I never bailed.
